question: The Prarthana Samaj was a reform movement within which religion?
solution:
The correct answer is option **3** i.e __**Hinduism.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Prarthana Samaj was a reform movement within Hinduism.
 
 
• It was a religious and social reform movement in Bombay, India.
 
• The Prarthana Samaj was founded in **1867.**
 
• Founders: **Dadoba Pandurang and Atmaram Pandurang.**
 
• The movement focused on the religious and social reform in Maharashtra.
 
• The popularity of the Prarthana Samaj increased after Mahadev Govind Ranade joined.
 
• **Veeresalingam Pantulu** was the Telugu reformer who encouraged the Prarthana Samaj in South India.
 
 
 
• **Hinduism** is the world's third-largest religion with more than 1.25 billion followers.
 
• **Buddhism** is the world's fourth-largest religion with more than 520 million followers.
 
• **Islam** is the world's second-largest religion with more than 1.8 billion followers 
 
• Digambaras and Svetambaras are the two major ancient sub-traditions of the **Jainism.**
